front.title: A Framework for Agent Discovery in DAWN

abstract.t: This document describes a two-layer reference architecture for discovering the minimum public information needed to reach AI agents. The Local Discovery Plane obtains discovery information within an administrative domain through mDNS/DNS-SD or infrastructure-assisted discovery. For cross-domain discovery, the Federation Plane uses publication of policy-approved information in authoritative DNS zones and on-demand resolution as its baseline; Federation Gateways apply export policy and validate and cache accepted results. The document also identifies optional functions that may complement this baseline where DNS publication and request-driven resolution do not meet deployment needs: recipient-specific sharing, proactive or multi-hop dissemination, and trusted aggregated directory queries. In mixed- mode deployments, DNS may bootstrap an endpoint that provides one of these additional functions.
